accepted_claims: For fixed kappa>0, degree zero, and j in the credited interval (4*pi,4*pi+epsilon_kappa), e(j) is continuous and locally semiconcave, hence locally Lipschitz; all constrained minimizers over compact subintervals form a strongly H1 compact family.
For every degree-zero H1 field with |J|>4*pi, the smooth pointwise-rotation momentum derivative is onto R3. Weak equivariance and finite-energy endpoint limits give the rank obstruction |J|=4*pi.

Every minimizing field has a unique weak variational vector multiplier alpha=omega*a. Exact finite-dimensional corrections yield continuous multipliers and uniformly bounded quadratic upper supports on compact subintervals.

The finite one-sided derivatives satisfy e_right_prime(j)=min over M(j) of omega and e_left_prime(j)=max over M(j) of omega. Extrema are attained, and every minimizing multiplier equals e_prime(j) at differentiability points.

Under the declared positive joint-rotation and Landau-Lifshitz conventions, a smooth minimizing profile generates frequency omega and is static exactly when omega=0. The missing nonzero-multiplier conclusion is not established.
not_claimed: A solution of the original non-staticity or quantitative-energy problem; the original target remains OPEN.
Nonzero frequency, a frequency sign or positive lower bound, monotonicity, global concavity, a full energy law or endpoint asymptotics.
Any range beyond the credited near-4*pi interval or constants uniform at either endpoint or as kappa varies.
Uniqueness of minimizers, smoothness of every weak minimizer, strong H1 compactness of arbitrary subthreshold sequences, or atomic quantization of the entire energy defect.
A new proof of the Melcher-Sakellaris existence/regularity input or the Brezis-Coron-Lieb compactness theorem.
Historical novelty or priority, exhaustive literature clearance, external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification.
scope_fields.publication_edition: Authored proof-only; exact full proof and all substantive audit findings preserved.
scope_fields.kappa: Fixed positive parameter; no uniform constants as kappa varies.
imported_inputs: Melcher-Sakellaris existence of a smooth minimizing representative and strict trial-energy bound.
Brezis-Coron-Lieb Theorem E.1 and sphere Corollary E.5; bounded H1 sequences with almost-everywhere convergence.
scope_fields.jacobian_energy_defect_distinction: BCL quantizes the signed Jacobian defect; absence of Jacobian atoms alone does not force strong H1 convergence or absence of all energy defects.
scope_fields.frequency_convention: m(t)(x)=R_a(omega*t)m(R_a(-omega*t)x), with partial_t m=m cross (Delta m+kappa(m dot x)x); omega is the multiplier of a dot J.
scope_fields.exact_gap: No proof excludes zero from minimizing multipliers, establishes nonzero e'(j), gives an effective frequency lower bound, or determines the endpoint energy law.
